title: Shrinking a one step devissage: standard open neighbourhoods of the base, of the middle scheme and of the point
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma is the one step shrinking statement: any standard open neighbourhood of the base, of the middle scheme of a one step devissage, or of the point in the source can be met by a standard shrinking (statement lines 969-989, tag 05HA). Part (1) is a base change argument, but parts (2) and (3) require real constructions: part (2) uses openness of the smooth morphism to choose a base inside the image of the given neighbourhood, keeps geometric irreducibility of the fibres, and lifts the local equation cutting out the preimage through the closed immersion; part (3) uses the finite fibration lemma to find a neighbourhood of the middle scheme whose preimage lies in a given open and then intersects. Those constructions are the substance, so the claim is H2.
